Game Overview

At its heart, Jumping Jack is a halloween game about bounce into adventure with Jumping Jack. Master simple pogo stick mechanics in a charming retro pixel world. Navigate crumbling platforms, dodge pesky crows, and time your jumps for high scores. Perfect for all ages, this game offers nostalgic thrills and endless fun with its playful challenge and engaging visuals.
